note:
For #124 (filling Canada's missing lakes). ftp.maps.canada.ca's robots.txt disallows /pub for scripts, which is where the data lives, so per your rule it comes to you.

Page: https://ftp.maps.canada.ca/pub/nrcan_rncan/vector/canvec/shp/Hydro/ (or via open.canada.ca: "Lakes, Rivers and Glaciers in Canada – CanVec Series – Hydrographic Features", Shapefile).

Files: the 1:50K Hydro shapefile packages, one per province or territory, named like canvec_50K_<PR>_Hydro_shp.zip. Not the FGDB ones.
- First, for the pilot on your view: QC.
- Then: NT, SK, YT, MB, NU, AB, ON, BC, NL, NB.
Sizes are unknown (the directory couldn't be listed); probably several GB for the large ones.

Save to: /Volumes/personal/projects/scenic-roads/sources/canvec/50k/ (zipped is fine). Tell me when they're there.

Why so many: the survey found 3,519 of the 15,375 map sheets in our Canadian regions missing their small lakes in OSM (~2.84 M km²): NWT 986, Saskatchewan 478, Yukon 442, Manitoba 413, Nunavut 377, Québec 371, Alberta 230, Ontario 168, BC 42, NL 10, NB 2. Map: scratchpad/lakes/survey/gaps.png.

reply: All 13 zips are in, and all check out (QC's full integrity test passed). #124's fill is built from them.
